_note: Word ceilings for always-loaded instruction docs. Policy, seeding rule, and the ratchet contract: docs/policy/doc-budgets.md. Ceilings ratchet DOWN; raising one requires justification in the PR. Underscore-prefixed keys are comments, not budgets.
_v4_12_attribution_justification: The new user-attribution capability requires one shared preflight rule in every platform template. Only that concise section increases these ceilings; detailed procedures moved to the installed git-attribution style guide. No unrelated ceiling changed.
_v4_13_open_item_decision_block_justific: Raised the five lockstep instruction-template ceilings by 7 words in v4.13.0. The Communication Contract closing-report bullet now also requires that each Open item carry options and a recommendation, because a bare list of undone work names a decision without saying what it is about, what the choices are, or which one the agent would take. The clause was condensed from 31 words to 7 by folding it into the existing Completed / Verified / Open / Next bullet and relocating the full procedure, the two honesty constraints and the worked counter-example to catalog/style-guides/agent-communication.md, which is not always-loaded. 7 words is the irreducible cost of carrying the rule at all.
